claim.claim-text: a drive assembly configured to move the dock between the first position and the second position; and an automated pipettor configured to aspirate at least a portion of a sample from a sample containing receptacle coupled to the sample receptacle carrier when the dock is located at the second position.
2. The sample processing instrument of claim 1, wherein each of the one or more magnets is a permanent magnet.
3. The sample processing instrument of claim 2, wherein the permanent magnet is a neodymium magnet.
4. The sample processing instrument of claim 1, wherein each of the one or more magnets is an electromagnet.
5. The sample processing instrument of claim 4, further comprising:

a sensor configured to detect a presence of the sample receptacle carrier adjacent the dock; and a controller operatively coupled to the electromagnet and configured to transmit a control signal to activate the electromagnet when the sensor senses the presence of the sample receptacle carrier adjacent the dock.
6. The sample processing instrument of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein:
the second carrier support portion defines one or more cavities; and each of the one or more magnets is positioned in a respective cavity of the one or more cavities.

7. The sample processing instrument of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the sample receptacle carrier is a circular puck, and wherein the second carrier support portion comprises a surface contoured to substantially match a peripheral shape of the puck.

8. The sample processing instrument of any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein each of the one or more magnets is positioned such that it is spaced apart from a periphery of the sample receptacle carrier when the sample receptacle carrier is magnetically coupled with the one or more magnets.
9. The sample processing instrument of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the drive assembly comprises a sample receptacle carrier track.
10. The sample processing instrument of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the drive assembly comprises:

11. The sample processing instrument of any one of claims 1 to 10, further comprising a diverter configured to move the sample receptacle carrier from a conveyor assembly to a position adjacent the dock.
12. The sample processing instrument of claim 11, wherein the diverter is a disc diverter.
